text: The 14 negative claims are isolated. This video reads claims_clean's real pipeline code to find out why its own data-quality rule didn't stop them.
The rule was never missing -- claim_amount_usd greater than zero was already checked, with Lesson 10's own bare @dp.expect, which defaults to warn: log the violation, keep the row.
The pipeline's event log already had the answer: 14 failed records against that exact rule, kept anyway, logged and queryable the whole time, just never watched.

The fix changes only the severity, to expect_or_drop, for the two rules that feed a dollar total. A full refresh replays Bronze through the corrected rule and removes the 14 rows retroactively -- Gold now matches the clinics' export exactly.
Every other warn rule in this pipeline stays at warn, on purpose -- the fix is watching that count, not banning it. Next: explaining what changed to Finance.
